summary.text: Catherine Allen is the Democratic candidate for Montana House of Representatives District 10 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 2 Democratic primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she listed school funding, property tax relief and workforce housing among her priorities.

paragraphs.text: Catherine Allen graduated from Beaverhead County High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Montana in 2006; Ballotpedia lists her profession as homemaker.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up in Dillon, has lived in the Flathead for almost a decade, has three children in public school, holds two bachelor's degrees in history and music, and sings in the Glacier Chorale.
Allen said in the survey that she wants to help fix the state school funding formula, raise the school inflation adjustment above the current 3% cap, and increase the Quality Educator Payment.

She also said she supports ballot initiative CI-129, which would cap annual property valuations on primary residences at 2%, and wants to keep public lands and waterways open and invest in rural clinics and telehealth.
The Flathead County Democratic Central Committee was the endorsement she listed.
